title: Sliding-Window Rate Limiter
prompt:
Implement a per-user sliding-window rate limiter. `SlidingWindowRateLimiter(limit, window)` receives a maximum accepted-request count and an integer window length in seconds. Its `allow(user_id, timestamp)` method returns whether that request is accepted.

At integer time `t`, count only requests for the same user that were previously accepted and whose timestamps lie in `[t - window + 1, t]`. Accept and record the current timestamp when that count is below `limit`; otherwise reject it without recording it. Timestamps supplied to `allow` are non-decreasing globally.

Target amortized O(1) work per request and storage proportional to the active windows.

example.input: limiter = SlidingWindowRateLimiter(limit=2, window=6); [limiter.allow('sam', t) for t in [3, 4, 5, 8, 10]]
example.reasoning: At time 10, the request at time 3 is outside the inclusive six-second window and no longer counts.
